title: The Inner Circle
description: Two Magisters voted against sponsoring you, and Elara spent more of her own standing than she strictly had to getting you this far anyway. The ceremonial duel is the price of the seat: beat her cleanly enough that even the two who voted no cannot call it a gift, and it is yours. Beat her badly, or barely, and it will read as charity for years.

objectives.description: Hear from Elara what the two dissenting votes will be watching for
Enter the Circle's dueling arena in front of the council
Duel Archmage Elara Moonweave - a yield only counts if it's earned
objectives.notes: Non-lethal duel via DuelManager.start_duel("archmage_elara_duel", yield_threshold 0.25). Elara uses all schools of magic.

objectives.description: Take the seat Elara spent her own standing to get you

notes: Threat: none physical - the threat is political, to Elara's standing on the council. Giver motive: two Magisters voted against sponsoring the player, and Elara spent capital she didn't have to spare getting them here anyway; a weak duel reads as her handing out favors. Consequence: named in the description (years of the seat reading as charity) but not modeled - the duel has no losing branch in the data. Final guild rank quest; unlocks repeatable research.
